deliveries_rider_when_active.name: deliveries_rider_when_active
deliveries_rider_when_active.value: "deliveries"."status" not in ('assigned', 'arrived_pickup', 'picked_up', 'arrived_dropoff', 'returning', 'delivered', 'failed', 'returned') or "deliveries"."rider_id" is not null

payments_collected_has_method.name: payments_collected_has_method
payments_collected_has_method.value: "payments"."status" <> 'collected' or ("payments"."method" is not null and "payments"."collected_at" is not null)

rider_points_rules.name: rider_points_rules
rider_points_rules.value: ("rider_points"."type" = 'initial' and "rider_points"."delta" = 50) or ("rider_points"."type" = 'completion' and "rider_points"."delta" = 1 and "rider_points"."delivery_id" is not null) or ("rider_points"."type" = 'rider_cancellation' and "rider_points"."delta" = -3 and "rider_points"."delivery_id" is not null) or ("rider_points"."type" = 'adjustment' and "rider_points"."delta" <> 0 and "rider_points"."created_by" is not null)

riders_home_complete.name: riders_home_complete
riders_home_complete.value: ("riders"."home_lat" is null) = ("riders"."home_lng" is null) and ("riders"."home_radius_km" is null or ("riders"."home_lat" is not null and "riders"."home_radius_km" > 0 and "riders"."home_radius_km" <= 30))
